description: This file defines the PdfSignatureField class, representing a digital signature field within a PDF document's AcroForm structure. It provides methods for rendering custom signatures, managing appearance dictionaries, and handling signature-specific properties and keys.

classes.name: PdfSignatureField
classes.description: Represents a digital signature field in a PDF's AcroForm, with capabilities to render appearance and manage signature-specific properties.

classes.name: PdfSignatureField.Keys
classes.description: Contains the set of predefined keys for signature dictionaries within the PDF specification.

methods.name: RenderCustomAppearance
methods.description: Creates and assigns a visual appearance for the signature field by invoking the custom appearance handler.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares the signature field for saving, including rendering custom appearance if set.

methods.name: WriteDictionaryElement
methods.description: Writes a key/value pair into the signature field's dictionary, with special handling for the 'Contents' key.
